column5: object_label
UK&W AEA 1925 ss.36 (vesting assent) + 40 (form of assent) + 41 (assent of personal representative) — PR transfers legal title to beneficiary via written assent

Scotland docquet system per Conveyancing (Scotland) Act 1924 — executry-attorney transfers heritable property via docquet (analogous but not identical to assent; heritable/moveable distinction load-bearing)
UK&W IHTA 1984 s.142 deed-of-variation — within 2 years of death + written + signed by all variators + not-for-consideration + reading-back-for-IHT-purposes (NOT other taxes)
Scotland deed-of-variation per T&S(S)A 2024 — analogous regime with Scotland-specific procedural variations
UK&W Trustee Act 2000 trust distribution — trustee transfers asset to beneficiary per trust deed terms; distinct from AEA 1925 PR assent
Scotland Trusts (Scotland) Act 1921 trust distribution — analogous Scots-law regime + 2024 amendment
Switzerland Erbteilung partition per ZGB Art 596-607 — heir-community partitioning estate (analogous to trust distribution in functional terms)
UK&W lifetime gift = Potentially Exempt Transfer (PET); 7-year clawback if donor dies within 7 years per IHTA 1984 s.3A
Switzerland Schenkung (lifetime gift) — Pflichtteil clawback rules per ZGB Art 527 (5-year clawback to forced heirs)
UK&W arms-length sale at market value — typically by PR during administration to realise estate for distribution
Commerce module partner-firm SDK consumer transfer — escrow release triggered by partner-firm-defined conditions; Phase-1.5+ Commerce module substrate

Muslim Quran 4:176 kalalah verse — additional substrate for cases without parents or children; complements 4:11-12
Hindu HSA 1956 + 2005 Amendment coparcener share — Mitakshara (by birth) or Dayabhaga (by death); daughters entitled equally post-2005 Amendment
Q-033 ProbateAdministration SM `assets-distributed` transition fired; cross-link via originating_event_reference FK to ProbateAdministration.transitions[]
UK&W trust vesting event (A&M beneficiary age 25; IPDI termination; discretionary distribution decision); Trustee Act 2000 framework

Reversed state — IHTA 1984 s.142 variation supersedes original distribution OR HMRC challenge upheld; TERMINAL from executed
